rationale: Both candidates independently surface the PR's central real issue — that Part 2 (nn.RMSNorm swap) makes Qwen-Image bypass IR op priority entirely, so Part 1's unconditional vllm_c default is validated on Qwen but actually affects ~14 other diffusion models with no data — closely mirroring NumberWan's ground-truth model list and hsliuustc0106's scoping ask. X presents this as one sharp, well-evidenced finding with a concrete suggested fix (scope via existing registry hook) and verified numerics/weight-loading/lint claims; Y makes the same point but buries it under ~6 near-verbatim restatements labeled 'resolved', which inflates apparent coverage without adding new signal and makes the actually-actionable items hard to find. Neither candidate catches the Gaohan123 'pytest mark incomplete' nit or the explicit pixelwise-accuracy-alongside-latency ask, capping recall for both. X's clean prose, precise line-anchored evidence, and concrete suggested diffs give it a clear edge in precision and actionability over Y's cluttered, redundant dump format.
